originality.rationale: The closest 2026 Section 6 gives a looser general inverse-list bound. Lenz–Wachter-Zeh–Yaakobi 2017 Lemma 5/14 provides exact binary deletion-sphere formulas, and Lemma 6/15 plus Appendix B supplies general alphabet bounds and collision criteria. The new final theorem centers on the q-ary maximum and exact number of ALL extremizers in both parities, not on claiming first discovery of the collision mechanism. Full primary text and mathematical-record searches found no exact parity-dependent enumerator. Residual risk includes implicit consequences of earlier general criteria and unindexed priority.
residual_risks: A general contraction-collision criterion from 2017 makes portions of the proof an accessible specialization; a stronger unlocated corollary may cover the enumeration.
Unindexed prior qary extremizer counts or accepted publications cannot be ruled out.
Only the documented one-error length-two channel is covered.
